offending_extra_words: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation to Vendor.
reasons: The operator flip in 7.2 ("need not disclose or match") alone achieves the locked preferred level by eliminating the disclose-and-match burden on Customer.

The inserted free-standing sentence duplicates protection already supplied by Section 12.3 ("Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment") and is therefore surplus to the minimal fix; it also introduces an unnecessary new term ("most-favoured-nation") alongside the document's existing "most-favoured-customer" usage.
Intent is preserved: 7.1 fee mechanics, the usage-based unit price exception, the no-hidden-charges sentence, and 12.3 remain effective and uncontradicted.
No walk-away issue; the deviation is one of minimality only.
